long_biography.plain_text:
Aarhus-born Mikkel Venge Beck moved from Danish football to Fortuna Köln before Middlesbrough recruited him after Euro 1996. A strong, mobile centre-forward, he reached domestic cup finals in England, later played for Derby, Nottingham Forest, Queens Park Rangers, AaB and Lille, and scored three times for Denmark. Injuries forced retirement earlier than planned.

Rather than become a coach, Beck used his five languages, club network and experience of transfers to enter player representation. He established Beckster International in Monaco and developed long relationships with clients including Simon Kjær. The agency now works across European markets, and Beck holds numerous current representation agreements with professionals, clubs and youth players.
long_biography.html:
Aarhus-born Mikkel Venge Beck moved from Danish football to Fortuna Köln before Middlesbrough recruited him after Euro 1996. A strong, mobile centre-forward, he reached domestic cup finals in England, later played for Derby, Nottingham Forest, Queens Park Rangers, AaB and Lille, and scored three times for Denmark. Injuries forced retirement earlier than planned.

Rather than become a coach, Beck used his five languages, club network and experience of transfers to enter player representation. He established Beckster International in Monaco and developed long relationships with clients including Simon Kjær. The agency now works across European markets, and Beck holds numerous current representation agreements with professionals, clubs and youth players.

uncertainties.detail: The source record gives Mikkel Beck and leaves the middle name and birthplace blank. Current English and Italian federation agent registers establish Venge as the middle name, while Danish player history and the identity-linked Wikipedia profile independently identify Aarhus as his birthplace.

Public databases vary slightly in club appearance and goal totals because some count league matches only while others include cup competitions. The biography avoids a career club total and uses only the Danish Football Association's stable senior international record of 19 appearances and three goals.

The Football Association records an eight-month suspension and £35,000 fine in 2022 for concealing or misrepresenting a dual-representation transaction. The sanction expired in November 2022. Current Danish, English and Italian records show subsequent registration or active representation work, so the dossier treats the matter as an important historical qualification rather than a current ban.

Published client lists change with contracts and transfer windows. The biography names only Simon Kjær, whose long relationship with Beck is well established, and otherwise describes the agency by its current cross-border structure and official federation agreements rather than a transient roster.

Sources establish a professional playing career, founder ownership, agency staffing and an active client business but do not disclose Beck's personal net worth, football earnings, agency revenue or ownership percentage. Wealth classifications describe documented work and ownership mechanisms without quantification.

Secondary sources identify Beck as the son of former footballer Carl Beck, but reviewed evidence does not show whether that background provided a material financial, networking or development advantage. The broader Self-made classification avoids claiming either an independent or advantaged start.

The source record already contains the correct Wikipedia page. No identity-verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or separately functioning personal website met the publication threshold; the mikkelbeck.com domain appears in official business email addresses but was not verified as a public website.

The existing biography is dominated by private-asset ownership and biographies of two other people. The proposed replacement removes all of that material. Private-asset data was used only for cohort selection and identity disambiguation, not for biography, wealth, social or tag conclusions.
